title: For apartment dweller
text:
For apartment dweller. This particular can is too small for a family of 3.
It will be great for a 1-2 person apartment.

product_metadata.title: Home Zone Living 13 Gallon Slim Dual Compartment Kitchen Trash Can, Stainless Steel, Step Pedal, 50 Liter, Black
features: Recycling Made Simple – Efficiently sort your trash and recyclables with dual compartments. The waste compartment holds up to 8 gallons, while the recyclable holds just over 5 gallons for a total of 13 gallons
Slim Body Style – The rectangular style is designed to fit in tight spaces around the kitchen and also provide a quicker access when placing against the side of a kitchen island wall
Easily Secure Your Bags – The included bag tuck band on each liner will help prevent trash bags from falling through the liner
Silent and Slow Close Lid – Our reinforced hinge controls the motion of the lid to ensure soft and secure closure
Durable Metal Pedal – Endurance and persistency were the inspiration behind our durable metal cantilever pedal
Dimensions – 21.97” x 11.58" x 26.58". Height with lid open: 44.50”
Custom Fit Trash Bags Are Available – Compatible with Liner Codes 20R and 30R
USA Based Support – Questions, concerns, or need replacement parts? Our Customer Loyalty Team is standing by. Please refer to the manual for contact info
